Card Q&A.a: No, it can't. It can only digivolve into a card with both the [Bird Dragon] and [LIBERATOR] traits.
Card Q&A.q: If I would use this card's  effect to digivolve my Digimon, can it digivolve into Digimon card with just the [Bird Dragon] or [LIBERATOR] trait?

Effect: [Main] You may play 1 [Pteromon], [Muchomon] or [Shoto Kazama] from your hand or trash without paying the cost. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[Your Turn] When any of your [Shoto Kazama]s suspend, ＜Delay＞.

・1 of your Digimon with [Avian] or [Bird] in any of its traits or the [Vortex Warriors] trait may digivolve into a [Bird Dragon] and [LIBERATOR] trait Digimon card in the hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 3.
